# Guild

> Saved guilds with cross-server sync and a client guild panel.

- Package: `Guild` · Category: Social
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Friend](Friend.md), [GuildLock](GuildLock.md), [InviteQueue](InviteQueue.md), [Messages](Messages.md), [Theme](Theme.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Guild")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Guild")` (shared/client keys)

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Guild.OnCreate` — `Signal<string, number>`
  (guildId, ownerUserId)
- `Guild.OnDisband` — `Signal<string, number>`
  (guildId, byUserId) — fired inside the guild lock, before Disband returns
- `Guild.OnMemberJoin` — `Signal<string, number>`
  (guildId, userId)
- `Guild.OnMemberLeave` — `Signal<string, number, MemberLeaveReason>`
  (guildId, userId, reason)
- `Guild.OnRoleChange` — `Signal<string, number, GuildRole>`
  (guildId, userId, newRole)
- `Guild.OnVaultChange` — `Signal<string, string, number>`
  (guildId, itemId, delta) — delta is negative on withdraw
- `Guild.OnInvite` — `Signal<Player, string, string, string>`
  (toPlayer, guildId, guildName, fromName)

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type GuildRole = "Owner" | "Officer" | "Member"
export type MemberLeaveReason = "kicked" | "left"
export type GuildMember = { name: string, role: GuildRole, joined: number }
export type GuildData = {
    Id: string,
    Name: string,
    Tag: string,
    CreatedAt: number,
    OwnerUserId: number,
    Members: { [number]: GuildMember },
    Description: string,
}
export type GuildMemberEntry = { userId: number, name: string, role: GuildRole, joined: number }
export type GuildInvite = {
    kind: "guild",
    guildId: string,
    name: string,
    tag: string,
    fromUserId: number,
    fromName: string,
    at: number,
}
export type GuildPendingInvite = { guildId: string, name: string, fromName: string, expiresAt: number }
```
